name: Lynna Jorcastle
source:
Illegitimate daughter of the Duke of Jorcastle, she was brought back to the declining family after her father's death. She has never been taken seriously by any of her relatives, so she started a life of luxury. Her character is domineering and she seems to see Magda as her imaginary enemy.

[From [url=https://helix-waltz.fandom.com/wiki/Lynna_Jorcastle]Helix Waltz Wiki[/url]]
